The AB Fitness wall
02 — Personal training

Coaching that
knows you

AB Fitness is run by Arlene Botha — an experienced coach, jog leader and ultramarathon runner who has spent years getting Galashiels moving. Training here is personal: small groups, real attention, and programmes built around your body and your goals.

  • 1-to-1 personal training — your goals, your pace, your plan.
  • 2-to-1 training — train with a friend or partner and share the cost.
  • Small group classes — the energy of a group, the eye of a coach.
  • All abilities welcome — from first-timers to seasoned runners.
★ Best Health & Fitness — Galashiels Heartland Awards 2025
03
03 — Outdoors

Fresh air.
Real people.
Real results.

Not every workout happens inside four walls. Run Club and Bootcamp take over Scott Park, Currie Road and the streets of Gala — training that costs just £2 outdoors and leaves you buzzing for the rest of the day.

From complete beginners to marathon trainers, the group moves together. Come once and you'll see why people keep coming back, week after week.
